content:
# Testament of Joseph — 11
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

**1:1** The-copy-of-the-testament-of-Joseph.
**1:2** When-he-was-about-to-die-he-called-his-sons-and-his-brothers-together, and-said-to-them:
**1:3** My-brethren-and-my-children, hearken-to-Joseph the-beloved-of-Israel; give-ear, my-sons, to-your-father.
**1:4** I-have-seen-in-my-life-envy-and-death, yet-I-went-not-astray, but-persevered-in-the-truth-of-the-LORD.
**1:5** These-my-brothers-hated-me, but-the-LORD-loved-me; they-wished-to-slay-me, but-the-God-of-my-fathers-guarded-me; they-let-me-down-into-a-pit, and-the-Most-High-brought-me-up-again.
**1:6** I-was-sold-into-slavery, and-the-LORD-of-all-made-me-free; I-was-taken-into-captivity, and-his-gracious-hand-succoured-me; I-was-beset-with-hunger, and-the-LORD-himself-nourished-me.
**1:7** I-was-alone, and-God-comforted-me; I-was-sick, and-the-LORD-visited-me; I-was-in-prison, and-my-God-showed-favour-unto-me; in-bonds, and-he-released-me; slandered, and-he-pleaded-my-cause; bitterly-spoken-against-by-the-Egyptians, and-he-delivered-me; envied-by-my-fellow-slaves, and-he-exalted-me.

**2:1** And-this-chief-captain-of-Pharaoh-entrusted-to-me-his-house.
**2:2** And-I-struggled-against-a-shameless-woman, urging-me-to-transgress-with-her; but-the-God-of-Israel-my-father-delivered-me-from-the-burning-flame.
**2:3** I-was-cast-into-prison, I-was-beaten, I-was-mocked; and-the-LORD-granted-me-to-find-mercy-in-the-sight-of-the-keeper-of-the-prison.
**2:4** For-the-LORD-doth-not-forsake-them-that-fear-him, neither-in-darkness, nor-in-bonds, nor-in-tribulation, nor-in-necessity.
**2:5** For-God-is-not-put-to-shame-as-a-man, nor-as-the-son-of-man-is-he-afraid; but-in-all-those-places-he-giveth-succour-and-in-divers-ways-he-comforteth, though-for-a-little-space-he-departeth-in-order-to-try-the-inclination-of-the-soul.
**2:6** In-ten-temptations-he-showed-me-approved, and-in-all-of-them-I-endured; for-endurance-is-a-mighty-charm, and-patience-giveth-many-good-things.

**3:1** How-often-did-the-Egyptian-woman-threaten-me-with-death! How-often-did-she-give-me-over-to-punishment-and-then-call-me-back-and-threaten-me-when-I-would-not-company-with-her!
**3:2** She-said-to-me: Thou-shalt-be-lord-of-me, and-all-that-is-in-mine-house, if-thou-wilt-give-thyself-to-me, and-thou-shalt-be-as-our-master.
**3:3** And-I-remembered-the-words-of-my-father, and-going-into-my-chamber, I-wept-and-prayed-unto-the-LORD.
**3:4** And-I-fasted-in-those-seven-years, and-I-appeared-to-the-Egyptians-as-one-living-delicately, for-they-that-fast-for-God's-sake-receive-beauty-of-face.
**3:5** And-if-my-lord-were-absent-she-would-speak-to-me-of-sexual-sin, and-if-he-were-present-she-would-drug-his-wine-and-give-me-to-drink-of-it.
**3:6** And-if-he-were-away-upon-his-business she-would-threaten-me-with-death; and-if-I-would-not-company-with-her, she-said: I-will-tell-against-thee-that-thou-didst-assault-me.
**3:7** And-when-she-saw-that-I-refused-her, she-caught-hold-of-my-garments.

**4:1** And-when-she-could-not-prevail-over-me, she-came-to-me-as-a-friend, praising-my-chastity and-promising-to-prevail-with-her-husband-for-my-behalf; and-when-I-would-not-be-moved-she-said: I-will-prove-my-piety-in-thy-behalf-by-my-praise-of-thee, before-the-LORD.
**4:2** And-I-was-greatly-grieved-in-my-soul, that-she-should-have-spoken-thus-to-me; and-I-remembered-that-Jacob-my-father-had-commanded-me-to-keep-myself-from-all-woman-who-was-not-his-wife; and-I-fled-her.
**4:3** And-she-many-times-flattered-me-with-words-as-a-holy-man, and-craftily-in-her-talk-raised-the-matter-of-the-sin-while-I-was-unaware; but-I-gave-no-heed-to-her.
**4:4** For-God-loveth-him-who-in-a-den-of-wickedness-combines-fasting-with-chastity, rather-than-the-man-who-in-kings'-chambers-liveth-delicately-without-offending.
**4:5** And-if-a-man-liveth-in-chastity-and-desireth-also-glory, and-the-Most-High-knoweth-that-it-is-expedient-for-him, he-bestoweth-this-also-upon-him.

**5:1** How-often, though-she-were-sick, did-she-come-down-to-me-at-unlooked-for-times, and-listened-to-my-voice-as-I-prayed!
**5:2** And-when-I-heard-her-groanings-I-held-my-peace.
**5:3** For-when-I-was-in-her-house-she-was-wont-to-bare-her-arms, and-breasts, and-legs, that-I-might-lie-with-her; for-she-was-very-beautiful, splendidly-adorned-in-order-to-beguile-me.
**5:4** And-the-LORD-guarded-me-from-her-devices.

**6:1** Ye-see-therefore-my-children, how-great-things-patience-worketh, and-prayer-with-fasting.
**6:2** So-ye-too, if-ye-follow-after-chastity-and-purity-with-patience-and-prayer-with-fasting-in-humility-of-heart, the-LORD-will-dwell-among-you, because-he-loveth-chastity.
**6:3** And-wheresoever-the-Most-High-dwelleth, even-though-envy, or-slavery, or-slander-befall-a-man, the-LORD-who-dwelleth-in-him-for-his-sake-will-not-only-deliver-him-from-evil, but-also-exalt-him-and-glorify-him, even-as-me.
**6:4** For-in-every-way-the-man-is-guarded, whether-in-deed, or-in-word, or-in-thought.

**7:1** My-brethren-know-how-my-father-loved-me, and-yet-I-was-not-exalted-in-my-heart; although-I-was-a-child, I-had-the-fear-of-God-in-my-heart; for-I-knew-that-all-things-would-pass-away.
**7:2** I-did-not-raise-myself-against-them-with-evil, but-I-honoured-my-brethren; and-out-of-respect-for-them, even-when-they-sold-me, I-refrained-from-telling-the-Ishmaelites-that-I-was-a-son-of-Jacob, a-great-man-and-a-mighty.
**7:3** Do-ye-also-therefore, my-children, have-the-fear-of-God-in-all-your-doings, and-honour-your-brethren; for-everyone-who-doeth-the-law-of-the-LORD-shall-be-loved-by-him.

**8:1** And-when-I-came-to-the-Indocolpitae-with-the-Ishmaelites-they-asked-me, saying: Art-thou-a-slave?
**8:2** And-I-said: I-am-a-household-servant.
**8:3** And-the-chief-of-them-said: Thou-art-not-a-slave, for-even-thy-appearance-doth-shew-it.
**8:4** But-I-said-that-I-was-his-slave, lest-in-seeking-to-honour-me-they-should-put-my-brethren-to-shame.

**9:1** And-now, my-children, observe-all-that-I-command-you; and-give-honour-to-Levi-and-Judah.
**9:2** For-from-them-shall-arise-unto-you-the-Lamb-of-God, who-taketh-away-the-sin-of-the-world, one-who-saveth-all-the-Gentiles-and-Israel.
**9:3** For-his-kingdom-is-an-everlasting-kingdom, which-shall-not-pass-away; but-my-kingdom-among-you-shall-come-to-an-end-as-a-watcher's-hammock, which-after-the-summer-is-gone-is-seen-no-more.

**10:1** For-I-know-that-after-my-death-the-Egyptians-will-afflict-you; but-God-will-avenge-you, and-will-bring-you-into-that-which-he-promised-to-your-fathers.
**10:2** But-ye-shall-carry-up-my-bones-with-you; for-when-my-bones-are-being-taken-up-thither, the-LORD-shall-be-with-you-in-light, and-Beliar-shall-be-in-darkness-with-the-Egyptians.
**10:3** And-carry-ye-up-Asenath-your-mother-to-the-Hippodrome-and-bury-her-near-Rachel-your-mother's-mother.
**10:4** And-when-he-had-said-these-things-he-stretched-out-his-feet, and-fell-asleep-in-a-beautiful-and-good-sleep.
**10:5** And-all-Israel-mourned-for-him-with-a-great-mourning.

---
*End of Testament of Joseph*
